summary.text: Jollibee is a Filipino fast-food restaurant chain and the flagship brand of Jollibee Foods Corporation (JFC). Established in 1978 by Tony Tan Caktiong, it is the Philippines' top fast-food restaurant and is among the world's fastest-growing restaurant chains, having expanded its international presence almost sixfold from 2014 to 2024.
